name: MultiSelect
description: A multi-selection dropdown built on select: checkbox popup rows (menu MenuCheckboxItem) that stay open while toggling, and removable chips in the trigger.

theme.note: MultiSelect forwards its theme to the select component; no theme of its own.

accessibility.keyboard: select trigger and popup traversal (arrows, Home/End, Enter/Space toggles, Escape closes, typeahead); the search field takes focus when shown
accessibility.semantics: checkbox rows announce their checked state; the popup stays open between toggles

sizes.row: menu row metrics: px-2 py-1.5, min-height 32, 14px type

notes: Split out of `select` as a sibling component: the popup rows need menu/chip (layer 3) and the select component's two-file budget cannot hold the family; the re-architecture plan gives different behaviour its own small component.
Checkbox rows are the menu component's MenuCheckboxItem (autoClose false), bound to the select data.
Value selection defaults to `multiSelectHandler`/`multiSelectPredicate`; `canUnselect` (default true) allows removing a picked value, `autoClose` (default false) keeps the popup open.
